result.title: Adaptive Multi Mode: Budget-Aware Routing of Optimizers By Online Landscape Probes
result.summary: The best classical optimizer for a continuous black-box problem depends on its budget and landscape. Existing routers decide from the dimension and budget, past improvement or features fitted to one benchmark, and few test an optimizer's implicit assumptions online. AMM (Adaptive Multi Mode) routes a known budget among quasi-Newton, trust-region, coordinate, multistart and evolution-strategy optimization engines with online probes of curvature, plateaus, separability, kinks, basins and fractal structure. Each probe has a default, a dimension-by-budget validity range and a cost charged to the budget. In its pre-registered development loop on bbob, 32 of 36 predictions held over the last 16 confirmations. AMM was then tested once on held-out bbob instances 101-110 (D=2-40, 10*D-1000*D) against up to seven competitors. It has the highest target share in 382 of 600 function-dimension-budget cells (236 outright, 146 tied) and, by a descriptive posterior rule, is credibly behind in 35, mostly at 10*D and 30*D. At every budget it also leads the controls built from its own engines (the best engine alone, the best engine per dimension and budget, and a greedy schedule), narrowly at 10*D and 30*D, and nevergrad's NgIohTuned. In pre-registered runs its lead over IPOP-CMA-ES holds under affine and box transformations, on box-constrained bbob and, pooled, on rotated f2-f4, but rotating the separable f3 and f4 removes most of the lead there. On held-out MA-BBOB its final share at 2000*D is level with IPOP-CMA-ES's and its anytime area lower. We published AMM as an open-source Python package (pip install amm-optimizer; https://github.com/BjBodner/amm-optimizer).

AI.brief_summary: 提出 AMM，在给定预算下用对曲率、平台、可分性、尖点与盆地等的在线探测，把预算分配给拟牛顿、信赖域、坐标、多起点与进化策略等优化引擎，并在 bbob 与 MA-BBOB 上与多个优化器比较。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「在线探测并在预算内计费、按景观性质切换求解模式」的框架，可能为 LVR 中按需获取证据、动态算力分配与停止决策提供类比线索；但该工作属纯黑盒数值优化，与视觉表示无直接联系，迁移价值需核查。
